name: Zeltplatz Leitzachtal
beschreibung: The Zeltplatz Leitzachtal is located in Weyarn and lies nestled in the hilly pre-alpine landscape of the Leitzachtal. The surroundings are characterized by meadows, forests, and gentle mountain ranges, which make a close-to-nature camping experience possible. Guests find basic amenities at the site, such as sanitary facilities and tent pitches. The atmosphere is considered quiet and close to nature, which makes the site interesting for those seeking relaxation. In the nearby surroundings, hiking and cycling trails are available that lead through the Leitzachtal and adjacent mountain regions. For winter sports enthusiasts, ski areas are within reach and can be used when snow conditions are suitable. The connection to the Upper Bavarian road network also makes excursions to surrounding towns and attractions in the region possible.
